normalization_policy: Comparison normalization never overwrites protected raw provenance. No fuzzy matching or name-only merge is automatic.

natural_keys.many_to_one_rule: Only an explicit approved duplicate group may map multiple source IDs to one target ID; retain one provenance record per source row.
